en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a harbor scene with several warships sailing out to sea. The foreground features a large battleship with masts and smoke stacks, while additional vessels and a low, built-up shoreline are visible in the distance. There are printed German captions describing the departure of the German war squadron from Port Said, as well as printed text indicating greetings from Egypt and the publisher's details. Handwritten signatures and a date are visible across the lower portion of the card, and postal cancellation marks appear at the top.
